per_query_caveat: poulpy's example averages the online phase over its own REPEATS=10 and exposes no seed parameter, so this row reports a single run with no cross-seed spread, where the raven and upstream rows report a median over 3 seeds. client_decode_ms is not reported by the example and is omitted rather than invented.
notes: Independent implementation of InsPIRe on the Poulpy FHE library — not a fork of inspire-rs. Interpolation construction (the direct analogue of the other InsPIRe rows here); the recursive InsPIRe² construction is published separately as inspire2-poulpy because it is a different protocol, not a tuning knob. Requires AVX-512F: the crate's avx512-fhe feature has a compile-time guard and only builds on an AVX-512 host. Database layouts follow the crate's DefaultPirParameters32B presets, which are 32-byte payloads only at 1/2/4/8/16/32 GiB — mapping to entries_log2 25..30. The cols choice per size follows the crate's own examples/README pairing.

online_work_scope.note: The online answer is over the whole database; no index partition is revealed.
